name: Code Review Mentor
description: An intelligent code review assistant that learns your preferences and provides personalized, actionable feedback on code changes with improvement suggestions

environment_variables.name: REVIEW_SCOPE
environment_variables.description: Scope of changes to review: 'staged' (staged changes), 'unstaged' (working directory), 'commit' (last commit), 'branch' (all commits in current branch vs main)

environment_variables.name: REVIEW_DEPTH
environment_variables.description: Review depth level: 'quick' (focus on critical issues), 'balanced' (standard review), 'thorough' (detailed analysis including documentation and tests)

environment_variables.name: LANGUAGE_SPECIFIC
environment_variables.description: Optional: specify programming language for language-specific best practices (e.g., 'python', 'javascript', 'rust')

environment_variables.name: PROJECT_CONTEXT
environment_variables.description: Optional: brief project context or specific concerns to prioritize in this review
